items.title: 3D Web Experience
items.tagline: Interactive 3D spatial computing environment & WebGL showcase
items.description: An interactive 3D web experiment featuring particle physics, custom GLSL shaders, and audio-reactive elements built with Three.js and React.

caseStudy.challenge: Rendering instanced particles and spatial audio in the browser while maintaining a consistent 60 FPS across both desktop and mobile viewports.
caseStudy.solution: Constructed custom WebGL vertex and fragment shaders using off-screen render targets and instanced buffer geometries with LOD fallbacks.
caseStudy.result: Achieved smooth, fluid animations and responsive touch interactions without overheating or memory degradation.

items.title: E-commerce Platform
items.tagline: Headless storefront demo with 3D product previews & checkout
items.description: A headless e-commerce demo built with Next.js, Shopify Storefront API, and Stripe, featuring interactive 3D product configurators.

caseStudy.challenge: Creating a modern headless shopping experience with fluid transitions between product discovery, 3D model inspection, and instant checkout.
caseStudy.solution: Integrated the Shopify Storefront GraphQL API with Next.js Server Components, client-side optimistic cart state, and a Three.js canvas viewer.
caseStudy.result: Delivered an intuitive, responsive storefront prototype with sub-second page transitions and modular cart logic.

items.title: AI Collaboration Dashboard
items.tagline: Collaborative workflow canvas with node-based editor
items.description: A full-stack collaborative canvas interface enabling real-time workflow design using WebSockets, node graphing, and responsive state management.

caseStudy.challenge: Synchronizing multi-user node graph changes and drag interactions across clients without conflicts or noticeable latency.
caseStudy.solution: Implemented CRDT state synchronization paired with WebSocket broadcasting, modular node layout components, and virtualized canvas bounds.
caseStudy.result: Built an interactive prototyping environment that smoothly updates connected client cursors and connections in real time.

items.title: Financial Analytics Dashboard
items.tagline: High-frequency market analytics dashboard with canvas charts
items.description: A dark-mode financial telemetry dashboard featuring real-time simulated order books, responsive Canvas charts, and custom data filters.

caseStudy.challenge: Handling continuous data stream updates without blocking main thread interactions or dropping UI frame rates during rapid filter switching.
caseStudy.solution: Used Web Workers for data transformation and batching, delegating rendering to an HTML5 Canvas layer instead of heavy DOM tree updates.
caseStudy.result: Maintained smooth 60 FPS scrolling and snappy interactive charting throughout high-volume simulated data streams.

items.title: 3D Rendering Engine
items.tagline: Browser-based procedural 3D terrain and geometry generator
items.description: A procedural 3D world generator running in the browser using Three.js, chunk streaming algorithms, and Web Worker thread offloading.

caseStudy.challenge: Managing procedural voxel terrain generation in real time without causing browser stutter on standard consumer hardware.
caseStudy.solution: Wrote a greedy meshing worker pipeline with frustum-based chunk culling to minimize draw calls and conserve memory.
caseStudy.result: Enabled smooth exploration of dynamically generated 3D environments directly within any modern web browser.

items.title: Real Estate Website
items.tagline: Modern architectural property showcase with interactive tours
items.description: A luxury architectural portfolio website featuring smooth page transitions, interactive floor plan previews, and custom inquiry flows.

caseStudy.challenge: Designing an editorial, high-end browsing experience that emphasizes architectural photography and interactive floor plan models.
caseStudy.solution: Combined smooth Framer Motion layout transitions with responsive image optimization and accessible form validation.
caseStudy.result: Produced an elegant, publication-quality real estate showcase concept optimized for all screen dimensions.

cta.title: Have a unique technical challenge?
cta.description: I respond to all custom inquiries within 24 hours.

items.question: What is your typical project delivery timeline?
items.answer: Timeline depends on project scope and technical requirements. A high-impact 3D landing page typically takes 1–2 weeks, while a full-scale web application or headless e-commerce build generally ranges between 3–5 weeks. I work on strict sprint milestones so you always know where we stand.

items.question: How does your pricing and payment schedule work?
items.answer: Projects are scoped at fixed transparent pricing so there are never surprise billings. Typically, we operate on a 50% deposit upon kickoff and 50% upon final delivery, testing, and deployment to your production domain. Custom milestone splits (33/33/34) are also available for larger custom projects.

items.question: How do you ensure 3D and WebGL experiences run fast on mobile phones?
items.answer: Performance is engineered from the first line of code. I write low-overhead instanced geometries, cap pixel ratios (dpr) strictly to 2.0, throttle physics updates when out of viewport, implement WebGL draw-call batching, and supply graceful CSS/2D fallbacks for battery saver or low-power hardware.

items.question: Can you work with my existing Figma design or design team?
items.answer: Absolutely. I frequently partner with design agencies, in-house product teams, or independent creative directors to translate Figma, Spline, or Cinema4D designs into clean, production-ready code down to the single pixel and frame.

items.question: What is included in post-launch support and revisions?
items.answer: All projects include 2–3 rounds of targeted revisions during development, followed by 14 to 30 days of comprehensive post-launch warranty support. This covers bug fixes, browser compatibility checks, and DNS/deployment assistance.

items.question: What tech stack do you recommend for high-performance web applications?
items.answer: My primary stack is Next.js 14+ (or React 19 + Vite for ultra-fast SPA setups), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js with custom GLSL shaders, GSAP/Motion for fluid physics, and Node.js / PostgreSQL / Supabase for backend services. This combination delivers unbeatable Lighthouse metrics and modern interactive prowess.

items.question: Are you available for ongoing monthly engineering retainers?
items.answer: Yes! For established startups and scale-ups needing continuous product development, design engineering sprints, and performance maintenance, I offer fractional creative engineering retainers with dedicated weekly hours and priority Slack response.
